Deposit New Money directly into that new eligible Business Advantage Banking account within 30 days of account opening ("Deposit Period"). At the end of the Deposit Period, all New Money deposits will be totaled to determine which Cash Bonus you are eligible for. $400: $5,000 in New Money Deposits. $750: $15,000 in New Money Deposits. Maintain a daily balance during the Maintenance Period. During the Maintenance Period, if your daily balance drops below $5,000, you will no longer be eligible for a cash bonus.
